summary.label: Structure
summary.text: Tiered: 6 tiers, gold caps 1,225k–1,500k (set per roster); added skills cost gold inside the team-value cap.

summary.label: Skills
summary.text: Primary 20k, secondary 40k, counted inside the cap; secondaries limited per tier (table); stacking up to 3 skills on a player; stacked players and stack limits per tier (table); stat increases (Tiers 4–5: +PA 20k or +AV 10k; Tier 6: +MA 20k, +PA 20k or +AV 10k; one increase per player, instead of skills).

summary.label: Elite skill tax
summary.text: Block, Guard, Mighty Blow, Dodge +10k each; limits per tier (table).

summary.label: Star players
summary.text: Tiers 2–6 only; max 2 picks from packs: Free (no fee, max 2) · Star (+20k once, max 2) · Super Star (+40k each, max 1) · Mega Star (+80k each, max 1); packs open per tier, some rosters differ (table).
